offer.text: My fire's nearly out and I've no trade to buy wood. Could you gather me 16 sticks?

accept.text: Oh, thank you! A warm hearth is all I ask for.

decline.text: That's all right. I'll manage... somehow.

in_progress.text: Found any sticks for my fire?

ready.text: Sixteen sticks! I'll be warm tonight thanks to you.

complete.text: You're a good soul. I won't forget this kindness.
